stories.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- Nairobi Senator Edwin Sifuna has accused parliamentary "gatekeepers" of frustrating scrutiny of the proposed Lamu refinery, just days after he filed a formal request for documents on the project with the Senate set to proceed on recess on October 9.
